title: Opening night: your card is in Apple Wallet, and Angelo said yes to the demo
when: 9 November 2026, 17:25 UTC (scheduled wake; since brief 18, 07:25 UTC)
headline: A busy day. The business card is on your phone and in Apple Wallet. Angelo said yes: his helper builds the side-by-side ABP demo by tomorrow. The Team app's redesign and messaging are on TestFlight. The summit opens tonight at 18:00. Nothing is decided here.

stats.label: to add the RiskMandate card to Apple Wallet (web-summit.sgit.ai/card/)
yes from Angelo to your demo asks
trials of the demo helper's prompt, all passed

for_you.ask: Add the card to your Wallet, and share the link with the team
for_you.detail: Open web-summit.sgit.ai/card/ in Safari on your iPhone, tap Add to Apple Wallet, then Add. Double-click the side button to show it.
options: you post it in the team's group
for_you.recommend: Share it tonight: everyone forgot their printed cards.

for_you.detail: The messaging vault's key was sealed to an old key of mine, so I cannot open it. Your messaging helper can.
options: Dinis's conductor re-seals it to me
for_you.recommend: Your messaging helper: it already holds the key, and messaging is its job.

for_you.ask: The venue map in the Team app: Apple Maps with our own drawing?
for_you.detail: Mapbox would not give us Web Summit's detail: that drawing is theirs. Apple Maps is free, needs no account, and is already in the app.
for_you.recommend: Yes, Apple Maps, after the summit's first days.

you_asked.said: A digital business card, and add it to Apple Wallet
you_asked.done: The green card at /card/, on your Home Screen in two taps, and a signed Apple Wallet pass made with Dinis's access.

you_asked.said: The side-by-side ABP demo, personalised to the visitor
you_asked.done: Designed; the demo helper's prompt is at version 3 and passed four trials; Angelo said yes; his helper builds the runner by Tuesday, yours reviews.

you_asked.said: Can we use Mapbox in the Team app?
you_asked.done: Researched: four options, Apple Maps recommended.

you_asked.said: A page from where I am to my registration point
you_asked.done: Six options written; Angelo's venues helper asked to build it on PrompTugal.news. Not picked up yet.

sections.title: 1. What happened since brief 18
items: The Team app's redesign (five tabs) and team messaging reached TestFlight at 14:23 (version 0.4.34); fixes followed in 0.4.40. Update PrompTugal Team in TestFlight.
Your helpers 8 and 10: helpers now report to me, and the infographic helper is on your list.
Your accounts inbox received one message that was not a valid report; it was dropped unread, as the rules say.
Your social helper drafted Tuesday's post: 'the demo is us' (2304b18).

next: Tuesday 10 November: Angelo's helper builds the side-by-side demo; yours reviews it.
Tuesday 12:45: I check how many helpers follow the token rules.
